title: Beca Doctoral PUCP - Programa de Apoyo a la Investigación Doctoral
official_source: Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP) - Vicerrectorado de Investigación and Escuela de Posgrado
duration: One (1) calendar year, renewable up to two times; the benefit cannot extend beyond the three-year programme plan (four years for the Mathematics doctorate)
description: The PUCP Vicerrectorado de Investigación (VRI) and the Escuela de Posgrado fund the Programa de Apoyo a la Investigación Doctoral so that doctoral students can dedicate themselves full time to high-quality, high-impact research; the bases frame doctoral programmes as the university's most advanced training level and the scholarship as a merit-based investment that removes economic limits on research potential.

title: Becas R.P. Jorge Dintilhac SS.CC. (PUCP)
official_source: Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru (PUCP) - Oficina de Becas y Credito Educativo
duration: One academic year (two regular terms), renewable annually up to the end of the degree as long as academic standing conditions are met
description: The Beca R.P. Jorge Dintilhac SS.CC. supports young people finishing secondary school in 2026 with excellent school performance, covering 100% of academic fees plus six complementary bonuses and three insurance policies, with only 14 scholarships awarded each year and allocated by faculty under PUCP's general scholarship regulations.

title: Programa de Cooperacion Internacional del Gobierno de Chile para Policias Extranjeras Uniformadas (CECIPU)
official_source: Programa CECIPU - Secretaria Ejecutiva, Ministerio de Seguridad Publica de Chile
duration: Follows the calendar set for each selected course; the 2027-1 cycle runs from 2 February to 30 November 2027 as listed on Paraguay's MEF scholarship portal
description: Chile's CECIPU programme grants scholarships to foreign uniformed police for Formacion, Perfeccionamiento and Especializacion Policial studies at the teaching schools of Carabineros de Chile and the Policia de Investigaciones de Chile, subsidising rent and food for day courses or accommodation and food for residential courses, primary medical and dental cover, and clothing and equipment for formation courses.

title: Programa de Becas de Investigacion para Estudiantes 2026-2027 (FCM UNCUYO)
official_source: Facultad de Ciencias Medicas, Universidad Nacional de Cuyo - Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales
duration: 210 clock hours in total: 10 hours for a Research Methodology Course and 200 hours for the research project, to be carried out over a maximum of six consecutive months from 1 February 2027
description: The FCM UNCUYO Programme of Research Scholarships for Students brings regular students of Medicine, Nursing and health-technician degrees into faculty research projects from early in their degrees, combining a 10-hour Research Methodology Course with 200 hours of supervised project work under the faculty's Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales.

title: Scholarships for Staff and Instructors' Knowledge Advancement Program (SIKAP), Commission on Higher Education Philippines
duration: Full-time or part-time study; CHED does not publish a fixed maximum duration on the programme pages read.
description: SIKAP is the Commission on Higher Education's principal graduate scholarship programme, funding teaching and non-teaching staff of Philippine higher education institutions to study for a Master's or Doctorate in one of ten priority disciplines within the Philippines. CHED pays tuition and other fees at actual cost and adds a monthly stipend plus a research allowance. Applicants are nominated through their employing institution, and awards are made in numbered batches against the CHED Regional Offices. The 2026 Call Cycle is open and Batch 5 closes on 5 October 2026.

title: TaiwanICDF Scholarship Program (International Higher Education Scholarship Program), TaiwanICDF
official_source: International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF), Taiwan
duration: Fixed duration set by the funded programme; the Fund states the scholarship cannot be extended and any additional study must be paid for by the scholar.
description: The TaiwanICDF Scholarship is the International Cooperation and Development Fund's International Higher Education Scholarship Program, which the Fund describes as offering full scholarships to outstanding students from partner countries to study in Taiwan through its TICA network of partner universities. Applicants apply to one programme at one TICA university per year through the Fund's online application system. title: Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan (Bolashak / Center for International Programs)
official_source: JSC "Center for International Programs" (Bolashak), Republic of Kazakhstan
duration: Not published on the page read; the application covers the full period of study.
description: The Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan awards government-funded places to international applicants at Kazakh universities. The operator is JSC "Center for International Programs", the same state body that administers the Bolashak international scholarship established by Decree of the President of Kazakhstan in 1993. The 2026 intake offered 490 Bachelor's places, 50 Master's places and 10 PhD places, applied for online through the Study in Kazakhstan portal between 30 March and 31 May 2026.
